decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 5 - 5		G1	The garage or car parking accommodation shown on drawing no's. 114, 115, 110, 112, and 111 shall not be used for any other purpose other than for the parking of vehicles.REASON: To safeguard the residential amenities of the neighbourhood and to ensure the provision of adequate off-street parking accommodation to avoid the congestion of surrounding streets by parked vehicles.

Condition : 6 - The development shall not be occupied until the existing access to Devonshire Gardens is closed and reinstated so that it cannot be used as an access across the pavement.
(Reason.  To confine access to the permitted points in order to ensure that the development does not prejudice the free flow of traffic or conditions of general safety along the adjacent highway in accordance with policy ENV.B.1.1 New development, policy T.4.4 Road Safety and policy T.4.3 The Traffic Implications of Development.)
description: Erection of single storey side and rear extension incorporating a single garage, erection of dormer window from rear roof, erection of new fencing, and demolition of existing double garage to house (Amended description).
